'''2009 2K Event Day 1 David McCune LS Hoth: Main Power Generators''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[David McCune]] at [[2009 2K Event]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)|Hoth-L-hothmainpowergenerators.gif|label=Hoth: Main Power Generators}}
* '''Deck name:''' ANSBM
* '''Username:''' DarkLordOTS
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
